description: M* finds an optimal plan for many agents with A* in their joint space, but it keeps that space small (*subdimensional expansion*). Each agent follows its own shortest path (its *individual policy*) until it collides with another agent. The colliding agents join the *collision set* of the state, and M* passes that set back to all predecessors; only agents in a state's collision set branch over all their moves. Recursive M* (rM*) keeps separate groups of colliding agents and plans each group with its own, smaller M*, and operator decomposition (OD-M*, ODrM*) lets branching agents move one at a time. The plan is optimal for sum of costs or makespan, and because the joint space is finite, M* also proves that an instance has no solution.
